config.placeable.title: Placeable All
config.placeable.option.enable.tooltip: Allows ANY block to be placed on ANY other block when Debug Stick is in offhand
config.placeable.option.ignore_top_rim.t: Allows placement on fences, walls, etc. (blocks without full top surface)
config.placeable.option.floating.tooltip: Blocks can be placed without anything below them (overrides other options)
config.placeable.option.blocklist_mode.t: ON = Listed blocks are EXCLUDED | OFF = ONLY listed blocks are affected
config.placeable.option.block_list.toolt: Block IDs like 'minecraft:snow' or 'minecraft:stone'. Empty = all blocks
